title: Analytical Derivation and Comparative Distinctness Proofs

mathematical_distinctness.distinct_from_B0: B0 enforces a fixed, memoryless ceiling C equiv 1.0. AATC introduces an internal state variable C_t that dynamically contracts the recovery asymptote based on cumulative borderline debt D_t.
mathematical_distinctness.distinct_from_M1: M1 (Persistent Floor) places a lower floor h_t on the slow-burn accumulator SB_t and latches on E > gamma. AATC places an upper ceiling C_t on trust recovery and activates on high-trust sub-threshold consumption.
mathematical_distinctness.distinct_from_M2: M2 (Recovery Dilation) scales the recovery rate alpha_t using an integer incident counter k_inc triggered by ANY transition from ALLOW to non-ALLOW. AATC bounds the asymptote C_t and does NOT trigger on overt false alarms, preventing honest device lockout.
mathematical_distinctness.distinct_from_M3: M3 (Rehabilitation Hysteresis) is a discrete binary hysteresis flag p in {0,1} cleared after 15 consecutive clean steps with zero continuous memory. AATC is a continuous stateful ceiling with persistent memory across episodes.
mathematical_distinctness.distinct_from_Family_C: Family C is a fast leaky accumulator Q_t with short memory (H=20) that deducts an instantaneous penalty from trust T_t. AATC is an authorization debt accumulator D_t acting on the asymptotic recovery ceiling C_t.

closed_form_dynamics.under_clean_rest: When A_t < q_low: D_{t+1} = max(0.0, D_t - delta_D). Debt clears to zero in exactly t_clear = ceil(D_t / delta_D) steps.
closed_form_dynamics.under_cycle_a: Attack pulse adds Delta D = (0.41 - 0.35)/0.1054 = 0.5693. Over 10 rest steps, nominal traffic sheds 10 * 0.10 = 1.0. However, when ambient packets occur in rest, shedding is reduced. As D accumulates across cycles, once D > 1.70, C drops below 0.80, forcing subsequent cycles into VERIFY.
closed_form_dynamics.asymptotic_trust_recovery: In recovery, T_{t+1} - C_t = (1 - alpha_0) * (T_t - C_t). Trust converges exponentially to C_t rather than 1.0.

failure_modes_and_boundary_conditions.patient_adversary: An adversary spacing attack pulses by tau_r >= 25 steps allows debt D to fully clear between cycles, evading ceiling attenuation (duty cycle < 1/26 = 0.038).
failure_modes_and_boundary_conditions.burst_benign_traffic: An honest device generating prolonged bursts of near-threshold traffic (e.g., heavy legitimate video streaming) may see its ceiling drop to VERIFY until traffic subsides.
